defs.def: having a greater than average height 人、建筑物、树木等

ex.s: A 35-minute hand-clapping, foot-stomping musical version of a Mark Twain favorite returns with this Tall Stacks festival.
ex.t: 一部35分钟、令人拍手顿足的音乐版马克·吐温名作，随Tall Stacks艺术节回归。

ex.s: Inhabitants of Boise, Idaho, watched with trepidation earlier this year as the city's oldest, tallest resident moved two blocks.
ex.t: 这家总部位于德克萨斯的公司开发并获得专利了一种挖掘和搬运技术来移动巨大的树木。

ex.s: There was no shade as the trees were no more than 3 feet tall.
ex.t: 由于树木只有3英尺高，所以没有阴凉处。

defs.def: used to describe or ask about the height of sb/sth （用以表示或询问高度）有 … 高，身高

ex.s: Rome’s Colosseum was 157 feet tall and had 80 entrances, seating 50,000 people.
ex.t: 罗马斗兽场高157英尺，有80个入口，可容纳5万人。

ex.s: “I’m going to miss you so much, Poppy,” said the tall, thin teenager.
ex.t: "我会非常想念你的，波比，"那个瘦高的少年说。

ex.s: For example, He was a tall man with curly brown hair.
ex.t: 例如，他是个高个子男人，长着卷曲的棕色头发。

ex.s: Writing an animal fact file (2 pictures) picture a picture b The red-crowned crane is one of the largest cranes in the world, standing at about 150 cm tall.
ex.t: 写一份动物档案：丹顶鹤是世界上最高的鹤之一，站立时约150厘米高。

ex.s: Reaching as far as the eye can see, these terraces cover tall mountains, often from the bottom to the very top.
ex.t: 这些梯田延绵至目力所及之处，覆盖着座座高山，常常从山脚一直延伸到山顶。

ex.s: I work in a tall, glass building.
ex.t: 我在高大的玻璃楼工作

ex.s: Then I’ll be able to survive even when the tall buildings are flooded.
ex.t: 那么即使高楼被淹了，我也能活下去。
